doc.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: 1950s clubs, Savoy dates and the Detroit sound
title: A forgotten Savoy date with Lenny Hambro
summary: The interviewer cites a 1953 Savoy date; Jones recalls little of it.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: There’s the date you did, I have it as 1953, it’s something else with someone named Lenny Hambro.
Oh, I’m getting confused. Hambro is also a concert pianist. Right, Hambro. I don’t remember very much about him. We probably did a date together I guess.
Well, I see the Savoy dates.
He must have been Caucasian, right?
Okay, because I see these dates and I see Clive Lombardi.
Sid Bulkin, drummer, would be on some dates. Then on the other dates it’s always Wendell and Clark or, maybe, Osie Johnson or something.
See, wait a minute… Didn't we do a show album, like a show tune from a Broadway show? Do you have that?
I don't have that information. All I have is the date.
Anyways, it's one of those date. It’s probably a forgettable date. I shouldn't have said that.
